versions.title: Belgian freelancer social-security contributions
versions.body: Belgian freelancers pay social-security contributions through a social insurance fund. The contribution rate is 20.5% of net taxable income. Freelancers must register with a social insurance fund within 90 days of starting.

versions.title: Belgian freelancer social-security contributions
versions.body: Belgian freelancers pay social-security contributions through a social insurance fund. The contribution rate is 20.5% of net taxable income, payable quarterly in advance. Freelancers must register with a social insurance fund within 90 days of starting. Freelancers who also work as employees may qualify for an exemption.
versions.change_note: Clarified quarterly rate and added exemption
